adv_25.name: Adventure tank, 25 L
adv_25.description: Tall, wide-shouldered and creased, with plastic knee panels. Range for days.

enduro_12.name: Enduro tank, 12 L
enduro_12.description: Narrow plastic tank with radiator shrouds down the sides.

angular_gt_19.name: Angular sports-tourer tank, 19 L
angular_gt_19.description: Folded from flat panels with sharp creases: a high front shoulder sloping down to the seat, flat sides and deep knee cut-outs. Modern big-tourer looks with the range to match.

touring_23.name: Touring tank, 23 L
touring_23.description: Broad and deep with knee recesses. Goes forever between fills.

fatbob_23.name: Fat bob tank, 23 L
fatbob_23.description: The big split cruiser tank: twin caps and a chrome console down the middle with the speedo in it.

peanut_9.name: Peanut tank, 9 L
peanut_9.description: Slim and tiny, perched high on the frame. Very bobber.

coffin_10.name: Coffin tank, 10 L
coffin_10.description: Square-edged with a flat top and a flush aircraft cap.

flyscreen.name: Headlight flyscreen
flyscreen.description: A little cowl and screen over the headlight. Takes the wind off your chest, just.

headlight_cowl.name: Headlight cowl
headlight_cowl.description: A little round cowl over the headlamp with a tiny screen.

bikini_fairing.name: Bikini fairing
bikini_fairing.description: A small fairing round the headlight, on the forks, with a short screen. Classic 70s look.

half_fairing.name: Half fairing
half_fairing.description: A creased, frame-mounted upper fairing with a proper screen. Calm at motorway speeds.

remap_ecu.name: Performance remap ECU
remap_ecu.description: Hotter maps and a higher rev limit. More power, still no aids.

remap2_ecu.name: Performance 2 remap ECU
remap2_ecu.description: The stage-two map: hotter still, with more room at the top. Ten per cent more power, no aids.

ecu_safety.name: ECU Safety
ecu_safety.description: ABS, traction control, anti-wheelie and lean-angle traction control in one box. Every aid can be switched and set from the bike's dash as well as on the dyno desk.

sport_ecu.name: Sport ride-by-wire ECU
sport_ecu.description: Traction control, ABS and anti-wheelie in one box. Set up for fast road riding.

race_ecu.name: Race ECU with IMU
race_ecu.description: Lean-sensitive traction control, cornering ABS, wheelie and stability control. Lets the rider push but catches the big mistakes.

compact_gps.name: Compact moto sat nav, 3.5"
compact_gps.description: A small rugged sat nav on a ball mount. Shows the road ahead and how far to go.

road_gps.name: Road sat nav, 4.3"
road_gps.description: A motorcycle sat nav on a RAM arm: glove-friendly buttons, the road ahead and the next fuel.

adventure_gps.name: Adventure sat nav, 5"
adventure_gps.description: A big rugged unit in an armoured cradle on a crossbar above the clocks: map, fuel stops and where you're headed.

rally_tablet.name: Rally tablet, 8"
rally_tablet.description: A rally tower's big tablet on a navigation bar: the whole route in front of you, with fuel and stops.
